items.text: A faster start: the first screen shows at once, and Settings opens in seconds.
Click a circle at the bottom left to pause what it runs by itself; click again to resume.
Connect makes no cards until you say yes, on a new install and after an update too.
Connect no longer suspends cards by itself; only cards on your list count toward its limit.
An episode's ⋯ has Mine again; words whose cards you deleted are listed, with Allow again.
Count as known starts as Suspended + Marked: a card you only suspend no longer counts.
Settings: sections under Cards, Library and App, a dot on what you changed, Reset with Undo.
Anki Miner cuts as many clips at once as your PC can carry, fewer on battery.
Sighs, laughs, fillers and song lyrics no longer count as words or become cards; names read surer.
A show's episodes always keep episode order, in Current too.
New arrivals: one row per show, skips clear at once, and hato's folders join their show.
